checks_detail.name: Default download uses reference keys and lossless empty focus objects for 20 neutral records with exact observer hashes
Original blank-form captions, control types and order are unchanged; no added note or mapping fields
Reader 2 imports and exports without losing null pairs or unknown metadata
Reader 1 current judgments and all provenance survive import/export without a repetitive completion banner
Human-key review imports losslessly; existing JSON-only support notes, pair arrays and snapshot digests are preserved
Reference-key reviews import unchanged and JSON-only why_selected is retained without adding a form field
Reviewed MT10 preserves ALIGNED, blocker=false and the checked m3_start anchor; local F7 checks pass without changing the review
Pair stays null until complete; choosing a source copies the exact prefix quotation
Original reading/focus/consequence controls are unchanged; source changes update speaker and quotes require exact own-speaker prefix evidence
Ten F7 fixtures check singleton/disjoint/overlap/empty/unknown/blocker rules without changing saved judgments
Known typed outputs do not substitute for participant-supported readings
Wording is hidden until opened; copying changes prose and exposure without judgment/verification/selection/completion
First-pass snapshot and SHA256 freeze once; later consultation preserves prior exposure and copied text cannot overwrite snapshot
A nonempty JSON-only selection reason is captured in the canonical snapshot and hash, then roundtrips through reference focus without duplication
Mismatched frozen hashes and unknown case IDs reject imports without overwriting current work
Reference/legacy alias collisions, multiple hypotheses, unsupported hypothesis properties and duplicate why holders reject without losing work
Unrepresentable legacy content stops export with an explanation, retains the editable draft and downloads after correction
Ambiguous aliases reject without overwriting work; unknown history and opaque consequence/participant keys remain unchanged
Public Audio source is not offered as a focal game participant
